Enrichment._comment: AI-Agent-1: the book-metadata Enrichment agent commits a field once its calibrated confidence reaches this threshold; otherwise it keeps cross-checking or emits 'unknown'.

Ai._SummarizeComment: RAG 'S2': per-chapter summaries are generated in the Worker during chunking. DefaultProvider is Ollama here, so this tag MUST be routed to 'openai' (the cheap gpt-4.1-nano) or it lands on Ollama.
Ai._PdfComment: ADR-012 S3: user-PDF vision→Markdown RAG parse runs in the Worker (chunking moved off the API request in #433). Must route to gpt-4.1, NOT the worker's Ollama default — mirrors the API's Ai:Routes:pdf.parse.

Pdf._ParseTimeoutComment: QA #3: hard cap on one vision parse so a hung OpenAI call can't run forever. MUST stay < the RagIndexingWorker 15-min StaleAfter so the timeout fails a slow parse before the stale sweep reclaims it.

RouteAlarm._comment: Sentry warning when one of these tasks resolves via Ai:DefaultProvider instead of an explicit route — the 2026-07-14 shape (pdf.parse silently fell to Ollama and pegged the CPU at ~390%). Throttled per (task, provider): a 106-page PDF raises one event, not 106.

Sentry._comment: DSN comes from the SENTRY_DSN env var only — never commit it. Unset ⇒ Sentry is a complete no-op.
